ordering_policy: Ordinary listings use neutral ordering. Sponsored or promoted placement must be clearly labeled and paid links must use rel=sponsored.
verification_policy: Only verifiable public business information may be published. Google Search may be used manually to discover a business, but the published facts must be confirmed on the company-owned website or an official public-agency directory. Do not infer service areas, copy reviews, or display ratings that cannot be maintained accurately.
correction_process: Business owners and users may report corrections, closures, removals, or listing claims through https://septicscope.com/contact/.
